entities.summary: Beatus Rhenanus, born as Beatus Bild, was a German humanist, religious reformer, classical scholar, and book collector. He was a key figure in the German Renaissance, promoting the study of ancient languages and literature. Rhenanus's scholarly pursuits took him to Italy and Switzerland, where he collaborated with prominent scholars like Erasmus and Calvin. His influence extended beyond academia, as he played a role in shaping Protestant theology and biblical scholarship. The Beatus Rhenanus Institute, established in his honor, continues to promote classical studies and religious reform.
